title: Build logistics overview read model
goal: Add the organization-scoped logistics overview contract, aggregate service, API, attention queue, timeline, facets, and source health.

evidence: Added the typed overview parser, fixed-query-count aggregate service, capability-gated route, registry entry, source health, readiness, attention, timeline, and facets.

progress.summary: Organization-scoped overview API and aggregate read model implemented and covered by focused contract tests.
completed: Authorized tours/events are resolved before batched downstream reads.
Independent source failure is represented as degraded or unavailable.
No per-tour or per-event readiness request is issued.
next_steps: Capture authenticated staging latency and payload measurements under RELEASE-009.

checkpoints.summary: Implemented and registered GET /api/admin/logistics/overview with the governed response contract.
checkpoints.next: Measure staging performance during controlled rollout.
